title: Without AccountingHub nothing changes for the organization
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Make sure the test location is connected to QuickBooks Online and that AccountingHub is not enabled.
  • Make sure AccountingHub is not enabled for the organization.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Accounting area is not offered, so there are no category rows to map.
